metadataRaw.title: Good Exercise for Neck Pain, Rounded Shoulders, Kyphosis, and Poor Posture
metadataRaw.description:
So are you looking for a quick way to relieve neck pain, and help with rounded shoulders and bad posture? Stay tuned!

In this video, Dr. Rowe (chiropractor in St. Joseph, MI) will share with you a good exercise that can offer you lasting relief.

At SpineCare Decompression and Chiropractic Center in St. Joseph, MI, our goal is to not only provide quick relief for a work related injury, but also to treat its underlying causes. 

To understand what may be contributing to your pain or other symptoms, we perform a thorough examination of your muscles, ligaments, joints and posture, and discuss any past injuries and lifestyle habits that may be contributing to your condition.

Dr. Rowe, chiropractor in St. Joseph, MI, has advanced training in complex joint and soft tissue problems that may cause neck and back pain and draws from a variety of treatment techniques, including chiropractic and spinal decompression therapy.
